limitations: This first connected implementation is read-only. It does not declare crm.records.create or crm.records.update until approval-bound multi-call deduplication, compare-before-write, and read-after-write verification exist.
Identity probing establishes host authentication and endpoint reachability only; target authority and record-read compatibility remain unknown until bounded schema and row evidence are observed.
Definition records expose mapped row properties only. Policy page bodies require a later bounded context-fetch capability.
Native provider responses and connected identity values must remain private and are never persisted by Core.
